data_description.active: Inactive vehicles keep their history, but their entities are disabled. Its cards are removed; reactivating it requires assigning at least one card again.
data_description.vin: Kept out of every state and log entry.
data_description.capacity_kwh: Required unless this is a guest vehicle.
data_description.cost_mode: Static: one fixed price for the whole charge. Dynamic: grid and solar shares are valued separately.
data_description.static_price: Currency per kWh, for the entire charge regardless of grid or solar share. Only used when the cost mode is static.
data_description.solar_valuation: How the solar share of a home charge is valued. Only used when the cost mode is dynamic.
data_description.cards: The identifiers the wallbox reports for this vehicle, e.g. an RFID uid or eMAID. Required while the vehicle is active.
